107:     # only its native handle-close boundary remains the fixed fake below.

109:     def __init__(self, disk):

114:         self.identity_failure = self.close_failure = False
115:         self.journal_path = self.journal_identity = None
116:     def _retain(self, value, kind):
117:         record = HandleRecord(value, kind)
118:         self.handles.append(record)
119:         return record
120:     def _owned(self, handle):
121:         assert any(item is handle for item in self.handles)
122:         assert not handle.closed and not handle.unconfirmed
123:         return handle.value
124:     def _close(self, handle):
